review.notes: Structure pass over the whole Markdown (no code fences; heading inventory reviewed against the PDF, two glued credit labels and one name split by a spurious heading found) plus a normalized whole-document diff of all 33 physical PDF pages (flat text matching plus per-page word/number token-presence checks). Every footnote body in the document (footnotes *-12) was dropped by the OCR while all superscript markers survived; all 12 bodies plus the *-footnote second sentence and the closing alphabetization note are restored from the PDF text layer, whose fidelity was validated against 300-dpi renders (physical pages 19 and 26 checked visually). The credit-pages team labels use headings in the existing OCR convention; only actual gluing/splitting damage was patched.
